title: Retrospective event-window baselines

method.outcome: paired mean observed PM2.5 for the same station, duration and replay case; lower is better
method.airwindow: forecast-ranked window retained in the replay artifact, selected without using outcomes
method.usual_cleanest: window start with the lowest mean observed PM2.5 in eligible earlier origins; confirmation uses development origins only
method.latest_window: latest-starting complete forecast window in each case's pre-ranked feasible set
method.full_replay: expanding-origin evaluation; baseline start is learned only from earlier origins
method.heldout: confirmation split; usual-cleanest start learned from development outcomes only
method.interval: percentile 95% cluster bootstrap of paired mean deltas, resampling whole forecast origins (2000 replicates, seed 20261111); negative favors AirWindow
method.origin_level: Each origin's statistic is its mean paired case delta (AirWindow minus baseline); origins with means below -0.01 µg/m³ favor AirWindow, above +0.01 favor the baseline, otherwise tie. Equal-origin Student-t interval uses origin means (df = origins - 1); exact two-sided sign test excludes ties. Sensitivity analyses, not superiority tests.
method.missingness: only paired cases with both subsequent observed means are scored; missing outcomes are excluded from the paired estimate and retained in coverage counts

limitations: Retrospective evidence, not a guarantee of future performance.
The held-out confirmation origins were previously inspected by analysts and are not independent calibration.
A confidence interval spanning zero does not establish superiority; overlapping cases within origins are dependent.
A fixed usual-cleanest time is a simple schedule baseline and may not represent a coordinator's genuine routine.
